prompt_fragment:
This asset is UI chrome or ornamentation. Keep it decorative, controlled, and cleanly cuttable from the background.
Keep decorative edges controlled and production-friendly for UI extraction.
raw_description:
A single corner ornament for the top-left corner of a page — elegant
cartographic flourish with small geometric motifs and a delicate
vine-like curl extending along both edges of the corner.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor corner ornament on aged vellum cream parchment, a single top-left cartographic flourish with geometric nodes and vine tendrils, punctuated by ember orange accents at junction points.

subjects.description: Top-left L-shaped cartographic border piece, fine nib-pen linework, geometric diamond and dot motifs at the apex, thin vine curl extending rightward and downward along both arms
Delicate curling botanical scrollwork branching from the geometric apex, sparse small leaf nodes, controlled elegant taper toward each terminus
subjects.position: along both arms of the corner piece
